This third amendment ("Third Amendment") to the Tenancy Agreement dated 2O November,
2015 further amended through First Amendment dated 24 June, 2019 and Second Amendment
dated 30th August, 2022 (collectively referred to as the "Tenancy Agreement") is made and
entered into at Lahore on this 11th July, 2023.
WHEREAS
(A)

The Parties entered into the Tenancy Agreement wherein the Landlord granted on lease,
and the Tenant took on lease from the Landlord, an area measuring 13,803 sq.ft at second
and third floors of a multi-storied building namely 'Pearl One' located at 94-B/I, M.M. Alam
Road, Gulberg Ill. Lahore ("Rented Premises"); and

Landlord's Initials:

THIS DOCUMENT IS CONFIDENTIAL AND PROPRIETARY

Tenant's initials:

Third Amendment

(B)

The Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Tenancy Agreement as per
the terms and conditions of this Third Amendment.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1.

The Third Amendment shall come into force on jst June, 2023 ("Effective Date").

2.

Pursuant to Clause 1.2 of the Tenancy Agreement, the Parties hereby mutually agree to
further extend the term of the Tenancy Agreement for a period of one (3) years,
commencing from the Effective Date and ending on 31st May, 2026 ("Extended Term").

3.

The Parties agree that the monthly rent of the Rented Premises is hereby increased by
twenty-five percent (25%). Accordingly, the monthly rent payable by the Tenant to the
Landlord for the Rented Premises during the Extended Term shall be Rs. 2,087,704
(Rupees Two Million Eighty-Seven Thousand Seven Hundred Four) per month inclusive of
all applicable taxes and maintenance charges ('Monthly Rent"). Now Monthly Rent is
Rs. 151 Per Sq. Ft. For the avoidance of doubt, the next rental increment of 25% shall be
applicable with effect from 01st June 2026.

4.

This Third Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Tenancy Agreement.

5.

All other terms and provisions in the Tenancy Agreement shall mutatis mutandis apply and
shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the
event of any conflict, the terms of this Third Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting
term in the Tenancy Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately.

6.

All expressions and terms defined or used in the Tenancy Agreement shall bear the same
meaning in this Third Amendment, unless otherwise specified herein.

7

This Third Amendment may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together
shall constitute one and the same amendment.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this Third Amendment, having fully
understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses.
